current_evidence.interpretation: The frozen round-1 gate supplies no eligible family. Do not reinterpret these ceilings or launch pilot 3 from this result.

requested_settings.limits: Fresh no-history sessions retain system instructions, tools, and shared filesystem access. Requested settings are not backend attestation.

eligibility.semantic_failure_definition: Observed grader fail status from a valid frozen case, including wrong value, wrong type, or input mutation. Verify the mismatch against the frozen contract and independently checked expected value.
eligibility.invalid_contract_or_oracle: Invalidate the family for this round, document the defect, and make no same-round repair or recollection.

development_calibration.selection: Include both pre-frozen held-out contracts from every eligible family. No ranking by favorable outcomes and no post-outcome task tuning.
development_calibration.insufficient_eligibility: Do not launch pilot 3. Publish unsuccessful calibration. A later round requires a separate justified bounded design and freeze; no automatic outcome hunt.

held_out_policy.difficulty: Unmeasured on the held-out contracts. Development-family variation does not guarantee held-out variation.
held_out_policy.selection_scope: Selected convenience sample conditional on exploratory development calibration.

intervention.machine_check: Decode each format and compare ordered clause strings exactly, including wording and punctuation.
intervention.example_policy: Use identical examples in identical positions or omit them from all variants.
intervention.limits: Markup, delimiters, layout, and resulting token-count differences belong to this intervention.

collection.schedule: Seed chosen and frozen before collection. Randomize task order and balance variant positions within task to differ by at most one.
collection.unresolved_missing_or_infrastructure: Report available counts and mark primary planned contrasts incomplete. Do not drop tasks silently.
collection.infrastructure_regrading: Documented regrading of the same immutable answer under unchanged frozen semantics is permitted. No new model generation or candidate feedback.

scoring.primary_outcome: Binary generation success requires all predefined cases, exact types, and input preservation.
scoring.case_counts: Diagnostic only; execution errors abort the batch and zero passed is not an observation of every prior case.
scoring.policy_readiness: Actual Docker headroom must be measured. Any change to execution limits is justified and frozen before collection and applied equally to variants.
scoring.security_limit: Expected values stay outside candidate containers, but shared-interpreter observations are not secure against deliberate candidate tampering.

analysis.task_variant_rate: p[t,v] = successes / 10, requiring ten valid scored outcomes.
analysis.report_units: Signed percentage-point differences with per-task rates and denominators.
analysis.weighting: Each retained task contract has equal weight; two contracts per family also give equal family weight.
analysis.task_unit: Held-out function contract; contracts within families may be dependent.

optional_exploratory_bootstrap.unit: Resample entire task contracts, retaining every variant and response.
optional_exploratory_bootstrap.sensitivity: Also resample pairs of contracts by family.
optional_exploratory_bootstrap.warning: Only 6-12 task contracts and 3-6 families. Intervals are unstable, descriptive, and do not establish population effects.

analysis.significance_testing: No confirmatory significance claim is prespecified in this draft.
analysis.power: Ten repetitions is a feasibility choice, not an achieved power calculation or guaranteed detectable effect.
analysis.all_pass_result: Report zero observed contrasts and ceilings. Do not infer format equivalence or replace tasks.

remaining_readiness_conditions: Finalize every public contract and independent oracle strategy.
Independently verify valid cases, goldens, semantic mutants, output transport, and real Docker headroom.
Obtain human review independent of reference authorship before confirmatory interpretation.
Freeze all six development and twelve held-out contracts before development collection.
Complete a separate 30-generation development calibration without outcome-driven repairs.
Qualify at least three families under the fixed gate.
Freeze the mechanically retained pilot-3 subset, exact prompts, dispatch schedule, and analysis before any pilot-3 response.
claim_limits: Better candidate access isolation, authenticated collection evidence, and independent human oracle review are needed for stronger confirmatory claims. This draft launches nothing.
